title: Pocketwire Savings Vault Opening Terms by Tier
content:
Each Pocketwire Savings Vault tier sets how many vaults a customer may hold that are not closed, the smallest first deposit that funds a new vault, and the number of calendar days after opening within which that first deposit is to arrive.

## Opening terms

| | Pocketwire Vault Essential | Pocketwire Vault Select | Pocketwire Vault Preferred | Pocketwire Vault Premier | Pocketwire Vault Reserve | Pocketwire Vault Private |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Maximum vaults not closed per customer | 1 | 3 | 5 | 10 | 20 | 25 |
| Smallest first deposit that funds a new vault | $1.00 | $1.00 | $1.00 | $1.00 | $100.00 | $1000.00 |
| Funding window after opening | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |

## Notes on the terms

- **Maximum vaults** counts every vault of the customer whose status is anything other than closed.
- **Smallest first deposit** is the lowest first deposit that funds a new vault. A first deposit equal to the figure funds the vault; on Pocketwire Vault Reserve a first deposit of $100.00 funds a new vault and one of $99.99 does not, and on Pocketwire Vault Private the corresponding figures are $1000.00 and $999.99.
- **Funding window** is counted in calendar days after the opening date and is the same, 30 calendar days, on every tier.

## Selection examples (hypothetical)

- A hypothetical Pocketwire Vault Essential customer who already holds one vault that is not closed has reached the maximum of 1.
- A hypothetical Pocketwire Vault Premier customer holding four vaults that are not closed is below the maximum of 10.
